name: ExecuteScript

parameters.help_en:
The database ID.
This parameter corresponds to the DatabaseId parameter in API operations such as https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html, https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html, and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141869.html. You can call these API operations to obtain the database ID
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID。
该参数对应为https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html、https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141869.html等接口中的DatabaseId参数，您可以调用这些接口获取
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en: The SQL script to be executed. The script can include DQL, DDL, and DML statements. Whether DDL and DML statements are allowed depends on the security control configuration of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 要执行的具体SQL脚本。包括DQL、DDL和DML，其中DDL和DML是否允许依赖于实例的安全管控配置
parameters.name: script

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the database is a logical database
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en:
The tenant ID.
You can obtain the tenant ID by moving the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner of the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。
取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud account UID of the user who actually calls the API operation. <props="china">For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html.</props>
parameters.help_zh: 实际调用API的用户的阿里云账号UID。<props="china">更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2835451.html。</props>
parameters.name: real_login_user_uid

Results.description_en: The list of script execution results. Each item in the list corresponds to a script execution result
Results.description_zh: 脚本执行返回结果列表，列表中每一项对应一个脚本执行结果

ColumnNames.description_en: The list of fields in the result set returned when a query script is executed

items.description_en: The field in the result set

Message.description_en: The error message returned when the execution fails
Message.description_zh: 执行失败时，返回的错误信息

RowCount.description_en: The number of records returned in the result

Rows.description_en: The data rows in the result returned when a query script is executed
Rows.description_zh: 执行查询脚本时，返回的结果数据行

items.description_en: The data in the result returned when a query script is executed
items.description_zh: 执行查询脚本时，返回的结果数据

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the individual script execution was successful
Success.description_zh: 单个脚本执行是否成功

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
